about: Recorded fixes of host-side files that build no image (DECISIONS 2026-11-23, lab/tools/public-export.py). 'from' and 'to' are the git blob ids of the file before and after the fix. A 'from' of "none" adds a host file the records' commit did not have (a kind's check of a record written after its series; public-export.py ABSENT).

fixes.what: The log line after a run printed the means of single/cache_on and stopped the runner when a configuration has no numbers on the core (DNedic lockfree mpmc::Queue on a Cortex-M0+). It now prints 'none'.
fixes.numbers: The line is printed after the run file is written and only writes to run.log; nothing that is read from the board, worked out or stored is changed.
fixes.control: 2026-11-23 16:41 UTC, the first image of the bundle that was on each of the six boards, one pass, no flash write: the same image checksums, and all 56 statistics of the library and all 56 of the baseline the same as in both runs of the image's record, on every board. On the NUCLEO-G0B1RE the configuration without numbers ran through (all numbers none, no error).

fixes.what: The pools concurrency series' runner watches the trial counters instead of doubling a wait: a run is judged when done is set, however long it takes while the counters move; a run that stops is read without a write, started once more, and judged. At f344730 ETL's image took a fault in the check after a trial and the doubling gave no file.
fixes.numbers: Nothing that is read from the board, worked out or stored changes for a run that finishes: its run file has the same fields, the same result block and the same verdict; only wait_s (now the seconds to the first look) and seconds differ. A run that stops (its trial counters stand still, done never set) now gets a run file where it got none: the result block as it stood, what was read without a write (the fault registers, main.c's phase and fired, the exception frame and its symbols), and the stopped trial judged with the host check's crash text (PF_CRASH) or 'a call did not return'.
fixes.control: 2026-11-27: test_runner.py (no board; NUCLEO-G474RE and NUCLEO-G0B1RE): every earlier case passes unchanged, and the new ones: done set late is judged, a slow run whose counters move is not stopped, a stall with a fault and one without are judged as above.

fixes.what: The concurrency series' decoder judges a run that stopped (stop(), stop_note()): the stopped trial counts with the host check's crash text, and the verdict says where the sweep stopped and that the cache-on half was not run.
fixes.numbers: A run that finished is decoded and judged as before, byte for byte. A run that stops (its trial counters stand still, done never set) now gets a run file where it got none: the result block as it stood, what was read without a write (the fault registers, main.c's phase and fired, the exception frame and its symbols), and the stopped trial judged with the host check's crash text (PF_CRASH) or 'a call did not return'.

fixes.what: The coverage map of the concurrency series reads objdump's instruction lines whether or not a space comes before the address. An eight-digit address (the Raspberry Pi Pico 2's 0x1000xxxx) has none, so no instruction of a Pico 2 image was taken: '0 of 0 instructions'.
fixes.numbers: Nothing read from the board changes. On the five boards whose addresses have fewer digits the map is the same: every one of the 68 records' coverage per function, made again from its run file, is equal. On the Pico 2 the coverage is now counted (the PS2 runs: adapter_ref 13 of 36 instructions).
fixes.control: 2026-11-27: test_decode.py parses an eight-digit, a seven-digit and a four-digit address line and leaves a literal-pool word out; the 68 records' coverage made again with the fix from their run files (records/pools-isr/RUNS.tsv), 0 differ.

fixes.what: The concurrency series gets a check of a record, as the CRC and pools kinds have: it rebuilds a record's bundle in the toolchain image from the sources of a commit (or of this tree, VL_TREE=1, which the ledger image-ledger.py uses) and compares the record's image (address and flash bytes), the boot stub, the bundle, the toolchain and the libraries' pins. The series' commit did not have the file.
fixes.numbers: It reads records and builds images; it writes no record, runs nothing on a board and changes nothing that was read from a board, worked out or stored. A record it cannot hold stops the export.
fixes.control: 2026-11-27: all 82 records rebuilt from their commit f344730 (kinds/pools-isr/bench/isrverify.sh, the six boards): 82 MATCH; two NUCLEO-G0B1RE records with a changed image checksum and a changed bundle checksum: DIFFERS for each, the unchanged record beside them MATCH.
